workflows.name: Confsearch
workflows.label: Conformer Search
workflows.description: Unified conformer search + energies via protocol (xtb-crest / xtb-md / censo-crest / xtbmd-censo).

workflows.name: PESsearch
workflows.label: PES Search
workflows.description: PES scan and TS/intermediate candidate extraction from a structure or upstream result.

workflows.name: BatchOptimize
workflows.label: Batch Optimization
workflows.description: Batch structure optimization with optional frequency, single-point, and thermochemistry steps.

workflows.name: XtbPathSearch
workflows.label: xTB PATH Search
workflows.description: GFN2-xTB PATH metadynamics from a frozen pes2ts_xtb_path_request_v1 payload delivered via --path-config.

workflows.name: XtbConstrainedOpt
workflows.label: xTB Constrained Optimization
workflows.description: Single-geometry xTB native constrained optimization (+ optional unrestrained physical single point) from a frozen pes2ts_xtb_constrained_opt_request_v1 payload delivered via --opt-config.

workflows.name: OrcaGradient
workflows.label: ORCA Single-Point Gradient
workflows.description: ORCA single-point analytic gradient (EnGrad) from a frozen pes2ts_orca_gradient_request_v1 payload delivered via --gradient-config.

workflows.name: nmr
workflows.label: NMR + DP4/DP5
workflows.description: CREST+CENSO conformers → mPW1PW91/6-311G(d) GIAO NMR → Boltzmann averaging + DP4/DP5 stereochemistry assignment.

workflows.name: singlepoint
workflows.label: Single Point Energy
workflows.description: ORCA single-point energy calculation at current geometry.

workflows.name: scan
workflows.label: Relaxed Scan
workflows.description: Relax an internal coordinate at each scan point with ORCA.

workflows.name: irc
workflows.label: Intrinsic Reaction Coordinate
workflows.description: Run an independent IRC from a transition-state structure.

workflows.name: tsmode
workflows.label: TS Mode Optimization
workflows.description: Directed OptTS along a chosen imaginary mode of an existing frequency result (reads its Hessian) plus final frequency verification.

workflows.name: casscf
workflows.label: CASSCF / NEVPT2
workflows.description: Multi-reference CASSCF single point with optional SC-/FIC-NEVPT2.

workflows.name: xtb_optimize
workflows.label: xTB Optimization
workflows.description: Fast semi-empirical geometry optimization with xTB (GFN-xTB).
